# RoundsVaultOutput
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/rounds-vault/RoundsVaultOutput.sol)

**Inherits:**
[RoundsVaultBase](./rounds-vault-base.md), [IRoundsVaultOutput](../../interfaces/rounds-vault/i-rounds-vault-output.md), [IRoundsVaultOutputEvents](../../interfaces/rounds-vault/i-rounds-vault-output-events.md)

**Title:**
RoundsVaultOutput

**Author:**
Roberto Cano <robercano>

Output flavor of `RoundsVaultBase`. Users deposit target vault shares and receive
ERC-1155 receipts for the current round. When the keeper closes and settles the round, the
frozen shares are redeemed from the target vault and the resulting underlying asset (e.g. USDC)
is credited as the round's exchange asset. Holders of past-round receipts can then redeem them
for that underlying at the round's snapshotted rate.


## Functions
### constructor

CONSTRUCTOR

Wires the Output-flavor rounds-vault to its target ERC-4626 vault and the protocol
access manager.

For an Output vault the deposit asset is the target vault itself (its shares); the
exchange asset (returned by `redeemExchangeAsset`) is the target vault's underlying.


```solidity
constructor(
    address targetVault,
    address accessManager,
    string memory receiptsURI
)
    RoundsVaultBase(targetVault, BaseVaultType.Output, accessManager, receiptsURI);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`targetVault`|`address`|The target ERC-4626 vault this Output vault wraps; settlement redeems from this vault each round.|
|`accessManager`|`address`|The `ProtocolAccessManagerV2` instance that gates keeper and governor entry points (e.g. only the keeper may call `nextRound`).|
|`receiptsURI`|`string`|The ERC-1155 metadata URI for round receipts minted on deposit.|


### _operate

INTERNAL FUNCTIONS

Redeems the round's frozen target-vault shares back to the target vault's underlying
asset and returns that amount. The underlying stays in this contract and backs
`redeemExchangeAsset` payouts for the round.


```solidity
function _operate(uint256 amount, uint256 roundId) internal override returns (uint256 outputAmount);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The exact amount frozen for the round (deposit asset for Input, shares for Output)|
|`roundId`|`uint256`|The id of the round being settled|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`outputAmount`|`uint256`|The exact amount the target vault returned after the settlement trade|


### _getFallbackExchangeRate

Returns the exchange rate used when a round had no deposits at settlement time.

Derives the rate from the target vault's `previewRedeem` for one full unit of shares, so
empty rounds still snapshot a sensible price aligned with what a synchronous redeem
would have produced at settlement time.


```solidity
function _getFallbackExchangeRate() internal view override returns (Price memory);
```
